title: Deployment-run QA
summary: Acceptance and execution use complete frozen plan/case selections. Authorized withdrawals, rematerialization and replacements retain source ancestry and target checks. An incomplete historical selection names operator repair recovery; raw historical requirements and results remain viewable without current-definition reinterpretation. Unfinished private member QA runs before shared groups on its own scoped cursor; completing it does not start a shared campaign. Member acceptance still requires all private and attached shared evidence. A member refresh naming its own plan with --plan rewrites only that member's rows, so a live run-wide walk of a shared plan does not block it. A delivery answers a member's plan only with run copies that passed or were waived; retracted or superseded copies answer nothing, so a plan whose only copies were retracted rematerializes for the item. An explicit plan ID or slug selects complete existing admissions for the exact run, stage, member or shared subject and frozen target without adding obligations or refreshing live content. New plans fill empty stages; explicit corrections retain replacement validation. A selector conflicting with a private member cursor names the existing execution and owner-resume recovery while retaining custody. A member snapshot plan with replacement_scopes counts as selected, so attaching that same correction does not report a missing frozen plan. qa.item_plan.attach refuses that attach while the member holds the correction on an executing run.
